cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. We said the concert would bring the village together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then we'll sing together without microphones.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Half the audience has gone home for torches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Look at that. The village is already supplying its own light.

mechanism: A professionally redirects concert roles so power failure and absent listeners become broader forms of the hoped-for village togetherness.
confusable: D212 makes setback magnify future victory; D236 sees the original hope fulfilled in altered present forms.
comparison: Collective singing/lighting differs from homebuilding sacrifice.
seedUse: Keep B's practical torch response and make A give actual performance coordination.
